core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sadia is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Fortunate”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sadia corresponds to the Arabic form سَعْدِيَّة (Arabic سَعْدِيَّة (Saʿdiyya) 'fortunate' (feminine)). Its core sense is sadia; happy, fortunate (feminine). Sadia is Arabic سَعْدِيَّة (Saʿdiyya) 'happy, fortunate' (feminine), a relational adjective from سَعْد (saʿd). The source gloss 'Truthful, Honest' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as saadia.

persian.name: سعدیه
persian.long_meaning: Sadia (سعدیه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن سعدیه، خوشبخت است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
